The document describes a rotary triple offset on-off valve with specifications for design pressure, temperature, and communication protocol.
It includes details on the actuator orientation, material of construction, and safety features like anti-noise and cavitation systems.
Valve Cv is specified to be at least 10% above design conditions, and it should pass hydraulic testing.
The document also mentions requirements for calibration certificates and functional testing in hazardous areas.
